topic.en: Structural fire safety and the energy transition

title.zh: 结构防火研究开始把锂电池火灾与建筑结构性能放到同一问题中
title.en: Structural-fire research is bringing lithium-ion battery fires and building performance into one problem

summary.zh: 伦敦大学学院的Fire and Structural Engineering研究组把建筑火灾、围护结构、可持续技术和锂离子电池火灾列为并行研究方向。这个变化反映出储能、电动车和数据中心扩张正在重写结构防火的边界：工程师需要考虑热释放、烟气、热暴露、设备布置、消防分隔以及受火后结构的可修复性。对土木和结构行业而言，火灾风险不再只是按建筑用途套用耐火时间，还要与能源系统、维护方式和事故后恢复能力联动。
summary.en: UCL's Fire and Structural Engineering group places building fires, the envelope, sustainable technologies, and lithium-ion battery fires within the same research agenda. The shift reflects how energy storage, electric vehicles, and data centres are changing the boundary of structural fire safety. Engineers need to consider heat release, smoke, thermal exposure, equipment layout, fire compartmentation, and the repairability of structures after fire. For civil and structural practice, fire risk is no longer only a prescribed fire-resistance period by occupancy; it must also connect to energy systems, maintenance, and post-event recovery.

watch.zh: 关注储能和电动车设施是否形成可审查的热失控、分隔和结构受火设计接口。
watch.en: Watch whether storage and electric-vehicle facilities develop auditable interfaces for thermal runaway, compartmentation, and structural fire design.

liveUpdates.reference: UCL Fire and Structural Engineering research group

title.zh: 澳洲研究团队用全尺寸试验重新审视混凝土隧道衬砌的爆裂风险
title.en: Australian researchers are using full-scale tests to revisit concrete tunnel-lining spalling

summary.zh: 维多利亚大学的结构防火研究以大型试验设施为基础，重点研究混凝土受火性能以及隧道衬砌在高温下的爆裂和失效机制。对基础设施行业，这类研究的重要性在于，标准耐火曲线和小试件数据不能完整描述隧道、地下空间或厚壁构件中的水分迁移、约束和热梯度。设计和运维团队需要把材料含水率、保护层、通风、消防介质、检测和事故后评估纳入同一套性能框架。全尺寸试验不能替代规范，但可以揭示简化模型的边界。
summary.en: Victoria University's structural-fire research uses large-scale testing to study concrete exposed to fire and spalling and failure mechanisms in tunnel lining segments. The work matters because standard fire curves and small specimens cannot fully represent moisture migration, restraint, and thermal gradients in tunnels, underground spaces, or thick sections. Infrastructure design and operations teams need one performance framework covering moisture, cover, ventilation, firefighting media, inspection, and post-event assessment. Full-scale tests do not replace codes, but they expose the boundaries of simplified models.

watch.zh: 关注地下工程的防火设计是否从单纯耐火时间转向材料、通风、约束和维修的系统验证。
watch.en: Watch whether underground fire design moves from a time rating alone toward system verification of material, ventilation, restraint, and repair.

liveUpdates.reference: Victoria University structural fire engineering research theme

title.zh: 斯里兰卡建立专门结构防火测试中心，防火标准能力正在向更多地区扩展
title.en: Sri Lanka establishes a dedicated structural-fire testing centre as fire-engineering capability broadens

summary.zh: 斯里兰卡科伦坡大学相关中心介绍其专门的结构防火研究、材料测试和性能化评估能力，目标是为建筑标准、工程实践和教育提供试验基础。它反映出一个经常被忽略的趋势：结构防火能力不仅依靠进口软件或规范，还需要本地材料、施工方法、气候和建筑类型的验证数据。对国际工程团队而言，跨国项目不能简单复制另一个国家的耐火细节；必须核对材料供应、试验方法、消防系统、施工质量和监管接受度。
summary.en: Sri Lanka's Center for Fire Safety Engineering describes dedicated capability for structural-fire research, material testing, and performance-based evaluation to support standards, practice, and education. The development reflects an underappreciated trend: fire-engineering capability needs local evidence on materials, construction methods, climate, and building types, not only imported software or codes. For international engineering teams, a fire detail cannot simply be copied between countries; material supply, test methods, fire systems, construction quality, and regulatory acceptance must be checked.

watch.zh: 关注本地试验设施能否把研究结果转化为可采用的标准条文和工程验收方法。
watch.en: Watch whether local test facilities convert research into adoptable provisions and engineering acceptance methods.

liveUpdates.reference: University of Sri Jayewardenepura Center for Fire Safety Engineering

area.zh: 结构防火与性能化设计

title.zh: 结构防火的核心不是把耐火时间做得更长，而是证明受火后结构仍有可接受的性能路径
title.en: Structural fire design is not simply a longer rating; it is a demonstrable performance path during and after fire

insights.evidence: University of Liverpool Fire Safety Engineering Group research themes

summary.zh: 利物浦大学防火安全工程团队同时研究结构防火、火灾动力学、火灾韧性、火灾经济评价和可靠AI辅助CFD。这个研究组合说明结构防火正在从单构件耐火极限，扩展到火灾发展、结构变形、疏散、修复和不确定性管理。对结构工程师，未来能力包括定义受火情景、选择热—力耦合模型、识别材料退化和连接薄弱点，并把结果翻译成防火分区、保护层、消防策略和事故后检查要求。AI或复杂模拟只能辅助决策，不能替代输入假设、模型验证和责任工程师判断。
summary.en: The University of Liverpool Fire Safety Engineering Group combines structural fire engineering, fire dynamics, resilience, fire-economics evaluation, and reliable AI-assisted CFD. The portfolio shows structural fire design expanding beyond a member fire-resistance time into fire development, structural deformation, evacuation, repair, and uncertainty management. Future structural capability includes defining fire scenarios, selecting thermo-mechanical models, identifying material degradation and connection vulnerabilities, and translating results into compartmentation, protection, fire strategy, and post-event inspection. AI and complex simulation can support decisions, but cannot replace input assumptions, model validation, or responsible-engineer judgement.

caveat.zh: 性能化分析对火灾情景、材料模型和边界条件敏感；复杂模型必须保留验证证据和适用范围。
caveat.en: Performance-based analysis is sensitive to the fire scenario, material model, and boundary conditions; complex models must retain validation evidence and scope.

insights.reference: University of Liverpool Fire Safety Engineering Group

area.zh: 混凝土爆裂与地下结构

title.zh: 混凝土爆裂是材料、含水率、约束和升温路径共同作用的系统问题
title.en: Concrete spalling is a system problem involving material, moisture, restraint, and heating path

insights.evidence: Victoria University structural fire engineering research and full-scale tunnel testing

summary.zh: 维多利亚大学将混凝土受火、隧道衬砌全尺寸试验和爆裂机理作为结构防火研究重点。对工程实践，这提醒设计师不要把爆裂简单归结为“保护层不足”或“混凝土强度太高”。高温下孔隙压力、含水率、升温速率、钢筋约束、截面厚度和通风条件会共同决定剥落风险。结构工程师需要把材料试验、火灾场景、构造细节和检查维护连成一条证据链，尤其是在隧道、地下车站、储能设施和厚壁构件中。研究结果有助于识别风险，但项目仍需采用适用规范和经过验证的材料参数。
summary.en: Victoria University focuses on concrete exposed to fire, full-scale tunnel-lining tests, and spalling mechanisms. The practical lesson is that spalling should not be reduced to inadequate cover or high concrete strength. Pore pressure, moisture, heating rate, reinforcement restraint, section thickness, and ventilation jointly influence the risk. Structural engineers need an evidence chain connecting material tests, fire scenarios, detailing, inspection, and maintenance, especially for tunnels, underground stations, energy-storage facilities, and thick sections. Research identifies mechanisms, but projects still require applicable codes and validated material parameters.

caveat.zh: 小试件或标准升温曲线不能自动代表地下工程；几何、通风和真实火灾荷载需要单独核对。
caveat.en: Small specimens or a standard heating curve do not automatically represent underground works; geometry, ventilation, and realistic fire load need separate review.

insights.reference: Victoria University structural fire engineering research theme

area.zh: 锂电池火灾与建筑接口

title.zh: 能源转型把结构工程师带进锂电池火灾、围护结构和恢复策略的交叉区域
title.en: The energy transition places structural engineers at the intersection of lithium-ion fires, envelopes, and recovery

insights.evidence: UCL Fire and Structural Engineering research focus on lithium-ion battery fire safety

summary.zh: UCL将锂离子电池火灾列入Fire and Structural Engineering研究重点，说明新能源设施的安全问题正在超出传统建筑防火分工。电池热失控可能带来快速升温、复燃、烟气和消防用水等多重影响，设备布置、楼板荷载、墙体分隔、通风、排水和事故后检测会相互耦合。未来结构工程师需要理解火灾工程和机电系统的基本接口，能够判断哪些结构假设需要专门试验或性能化分析。它并不意味着结构师独立负责全部消防设计，而是要求在方案阶段把接口和责任边界写清楚。
summary.en: UCL's Fire and Structural Engineering group identifies lithium-ion battery fires as a research focus, showing that energy-transition safety is moving beyond traditional building-fire boundaries. Thermal runaway can involve rapid heating, re-ignition, smoke, and firefighting water, while equipment layout, floor loading, compartment walls, ventilation, drainage, and post-event inspection become coupled. Structural engineers will need enough fire and building-services understanding to identify which assumptions require special testing or performance-based analysis. This does not make the structural engineer solely responsible for fire design; it requires interfaces and responsibility boundaries to be explicit at concept stage.

caveat.zh: 电池系统、消防策略和建筑结构必须由相应专业共同设计；不能用普通仓储火灾假设替代系统级风险评估。
caveat.en: Battery systems, fire strategy, and structure require coordinated specialist design; an ordinary warehouse-fire assumption is not a system risk assessment.

insights.reference: UCL Fire and Structural Engineering group

title.zh: 防火设计不是把构件加厚：中外规范如何把温度、材料退化和结构系统联系起来？
title.en: Fire design is not simply thicker members: how Chinese and international practice links temperature, degradation, and structural systems

text.zh: 结构防火设计的基本问题，是结构在规定或性能化火灾情景下能否保持所需的承载、变形和整体稳定。中国规范体系通常通过耐火极限、构件耐火等级、保护层和高温材料性能组织设计；Eurocode 3、Eurocode 4和澳洲相关设计实践则常将标准火灾、热分析、温度相关材料参数和结构分析分层处理。美国性能化实践还会结合火灾动力学、构件保护、整体框架响应和验收目标。不同体系的共同点是：火灾下的钢材强度、刚度、连接性能和混凝土爆裂不能继续按常温值使用。工程师应先定义火灾情景和功能目标，再确定热分析、力学分析、保护系统和事故后恢复要求。
text.en: Structural fire design asks whether a structure can retain the required capacity, deformation control, and global stability under a prescribed or performance-based fire scenario. Chinese practice commonly organises design through fire-resistance ratings, member classes, cover, and temperature-dependent material behaviour. Eurocode 3, Eurocode 4, and Australian practice often separate the standard fire, thermal analysis, temperature-dependent properties, and structural analysis. US performance-based practice may also combine fire dynamics, protection, frame response, and acceptance objectives. The common principle is that steel strength, stiffness, connection behaviour, and concrete spalling cannot retain room-temperature values in fire. Engineers should define the fire scenario and functional objective before selecting thermal analysis, mechanical analysis, protection, and recovery requirements.

label.zh: 耐火时间不是结构响应本身
label.en: A fire rating is not the structural response itself

text.zh: 耐火时间是验收指标，背后仍需说明受火面、升温曲线、荷载、约束、保护系统和变形限值。
text.en: A fire rating is an acceptance metric; the heated faces, heating curve, load, restraint, protection, and deformation limit still need to be defined.

label.zh: 高温材料参数必须随温度变化
label.en: Material parameters must vary with temperature

text.zh: 钢材弹性模量、屈服强度和混凝土强度会随温度退化；常温截面验算不能直接代表受火状态。
text.en: Steel modulus, yield strength, and concrete strength degrade with temperature; a room-temperature section check does not represent the fire condition.

label.zh: 构件验算与系统稳定要分层核对
label.en: Member checks and system stability need separate layers

text.zh: 局部构件满足耐火时间不代表框架、连接、楼板和围护系统在受火和降温后仍有可接受的整体性能。
text.en: A member meeting a time rating does not prove that the frame, joints, slabs, and envelope retain acceptable system performance during heating and cooling.

takeaway.zh: 防火设计的第一步不是选择保护层厚度，而是明确火灾情景、功能目标和结构系统的受火路径；随后才有意义地选择材料参数、热分析和耐火构造。
takeaway.en: The first step in fire design is not selecting a protection thickness; it is defining the fire scenario, functional objective, and heated load path of the structural system. Material properties, thermal analysis, and protection details follow from that definition.

title.zh: 参考实例：受火构件的温度退化与承载力筛查
title.en: Worked reference: temperature degradation and capacity screening for a heated member

intro.zh: 以下关系用于解释结构防火的概念流程，属于派生关系和简化筛查，不是某一规范条文的逐字转录。正式设计应采用适用的GB、AS、EN或美国规范、保护系统数据、热分析方法和高温材料参数。
intro.en: The relations below explain the conceptual workflow of structural fire design. They are derived relations and simplified screens, not verbatim reproductions of one code clause. Formal design must use the applicable GB, AS, EN, or US provisions, protection data, thermal method, and high-temperature material properties.

label.zh: 温度升高定义（派生关系）

citation.zh: Derived relation：以构件温度θ与初始温度θ₀表示温升；火灾温度和构件温度需要通过适用热分析或试验确定。
citation.en: Derived relation: expresses temperature rise from member temperature θ and initial temperature θ₀. Fire and member temperatures must come from the applicable thermal analysis or test.

label.zh: 高温刚度退化的概念表达
label.en: Conceptual expression of stiffness degradation at elevated temperature

citation.zh: Derived relation：以温度相关系数kE(θ)表示弹性模量退化；正式取值必须引用适用材料规范或标准化试验数据。
citation.en: Derived relation: represents modulus degradation with the temperature-dependent factor kE(θ). Formal values must be taken from the applicable material standard or standardised test data.

citation.zh: Code-format citation：表示火灾设计作用效应不超过受火设计抗力；具体荷载组合、材料折减、保护层、约束和变形限值必须按适用规范确定，不能把常温抗力直接带入。
citation.en: Code-format citation: the fire design action effect does not exceed the fire design resistance. Load combination, material reduction, protection, restraint, and deformation limits must follow the applicable standard; room-temperature resistance cannot be used directly.

note.zh: 例如，若热分析得到钢构件温度由20°C升至550°C，设计师应按适用规范采用550°C下的强度和刚度参数，再检查受火组合与变形，而不是只把常温承载力乘一个未经引用的经验系数。
note.en: For example, if thermal analysis raises a steel member from 20°C to 550°C, the designer should use the applicable standard's strength and stiffness parameters at 550°C and then check the fire combination and deformation, rather than multiplying room-temperature capacity by an uncited empirical factor.
